user.title: ROI Tracker – add an asset
user.description: Pick a template. It determines which fields are offered next.

setup.title: Set up asset
setup.description: Enter the investment and your existing sensors. Amount sensors must be **cumulative meter readings** (kWh), not instantaneous power (kW). Leave fields you don't have empty.

data.name: Asset name
data.start_date: Start date (optional, can be in the past)
data.price_mode: Where does your electricity price (import) come from?
data.reward_mode: Where does your feed-in tariff come from?

data_description.investment: One-time investment in € that should pay off (e.g. 20000).
data_description.start_date: Optionally a date in the past. The calculation starts retroactively from that day using stored sensor history.
data_description.consumption_sensor: Self-consumption in kWh – the electricity you use directly from PV or battery. NOT grid import. Savings = this × electricity price.
data_description.export_sensor: Energy exported to the grid in kWh. Revenue = this × feed-in tariff.
data_description.battery_discharge_sensor: Energy discharged from battery in kWh. Counted as savings (× electricity price).
data_description.grid_import_sensor: Optional: cumulative grid import in kWh (e.g. from Tibber or smart meter). NOT subtracted from ROI – shown transparently so you can see how much you still buy from the grid.
data_description.price_mode: Determines how the monetary value of your self-consumption is calculated.
data_description.sensor_reset_daily: Enable if your sensors reset daily (e.g. daily yield from inverter) or monthly instead of accumulating permanently. On detecting a reset, the current value is counted as the partial day's energy.

sources.title: Prices & feed-in
sources.description: Enter the values matching your selection. Prices always in **€ per kWh** (e.g. 0.30).

data_description.price_fixed: Your energy price per kWh, e.g. 0.30.
data_description.price_sensor: A sensor providing the current energy price in €/kWh (e.g. Tibber). Each self-used kWh is valued at the price at that moment.
data_description.cost_sensor: Only choose this if you have a sensor accumulating the saved amount in €. NOT your electricity bill – that would be expenses, not savings.
data_description.reward_fixed: Your feed-in tariff per kWh, e.g. 0.082.
data_description.reward_sensor: A sensor accumulating the feed-in revenue received in €.

init.title: Edit asset
init.description: Adjust investment, sensors and price sources.

data.name: Asset name
data.start_date: Start date (optional, can be in the past)
data.price_mode: Where does your electricity price (import) come from?
data.reward_mode: Where does your feed-in tariff come from?

data_description.consumption_sensor: Self-consumption from PV/battery – NOT grid import.
data_description.grid_import_sensor: Optional: cumulative grid import (display only, not deducted from ROI).

sources.title: Prices & feed-in
sources.description: Enter the values matching your selection.

data_description.price_sensor: Sensor with the current energy price in €/kWh (e.g. Tibber).
data_description.cost_sensor: Only a sensor accumulating the saved amount in € – not the electricity bill.

reset.name: Reset
reset.description: Resets a ROI calculator to zero. All accumulated values and the stored state are cleared.

recalculate.name: Recalculate retroactively
recalculate.description: Resets a ROI calculator and recalculates it retroactively from the stored sensor history.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: Date to calculate from (optional; otherwise the start date configured on the asset).
